title: Built the auto-manager
description: Connects to the live FPL account through its official login flow, pulls official player/fixture data, and can submit real transfers, lineups, and captaincy changes.

title: Switched to a proper squad optimizer
description: Replaced one-swap-at-a-time transfer logic with an integer linear program (PuLP/CBC) that considers the whole 15-player squad and budget jointly, so it can see combinations a step-by-step search would miss.

title: Added a daily preview
description: Recommendations are now written out ahead of each deadline so they're visible before anything is actually submitted.

title: Documented the full strategy
description: Published a complete internal reference for the scoring model - this page is the public-facing version of it.

title: Position-aware fixture difficulty + rotation risk
description: Defenders/keepers are now scored on the opponent's attacking threat, attackers on the opponent's defensive solidity, instead of one blunt fixture-difficulty number. Also added a discount for players who don't reliably start (starts-per-90 below 1.0 with a real sample size).

title: Fixed captaincy to score this week only
description: Captaincy previously used the same multi-week horizon score as squad selection. Since captaincy can be changed every single week for free, it's now scored purely on that week's projection, ignoring the fixture run beyond it.

title: Tested a hunch, didn't ship it
description: Considered flipping the sign of the underlying-stats (xG) signal based on an isolated correlation that looked backwards. Backtested the full formula instead of trusting the isolated number - the current sign scores better (r=0.571 vs 0.563 flipped) - so it stayed as is.

title: Fixed the optimizer overvaluing the bench
description: A backup goalkeeper was being valued almost like a starter, even though a benched player only scores when actually subbed in (rare). Bench value is now discounted to 15% of a player's projected score.

title: Added a real defensive-strength signal
description: Each team's underlying expected goals conceded is now factored in for goalkeepers and defenders - a strong defense's player is more likely to keep a clean sheet than a leaky defense's, beyond what the player's own season stats capture on their own.

title: Built a captaincy-specific backtest
description: Correlating with points in general isn't the same test as "picks the right captain out of a pool of candidates." A dedicated simulation confirmed the current formula's captain picks scored about 0.46 points/gameweek more, on average, than dropping the underlying-stats signal, across 56 simulated real gameweeks.

title: Went live
description: Turned off dry-run mode - the tool now submits real transfers and lineup changes ahead of each deadline, not just recommendations.

title: Fixed a bench substitute-order bug
description: The reserve goalkeeper's bench slot was correct, but outfield substitutes were being ordered by position type instead of actual projected score. Found and fixed against the live account.

title: Launched this site
description: A public, read-only view of the live squad, the decision model, and this change feed.

title: Published this page's real weights and numbers
description: Rebuilt this page to show the actual scoring weights, optimizer constants, and backtest results, instead of a high-level summary.

title: Added a set-piece duty bonus
description: Confirmed penalty/free-kick/corner takers now get a small direct bonus - catches a player who just inherited duty before it shows up in their own scoring stats. Not backtested the same way as the other weights (explained above) - applied as standard football-analytics practice instead.

title: Tested defensive contribution and BPS trend - didn't ship either
description: FPL's new tackles/interceptions/clearances threshold bonus looked promising as a recent-form signal (+0.016 to +0.023 to prediction accuracy), but that version needs per-player history that isn't cheaply available for the whole player pool. Retested with the version that's actually buildable in bulk and the improvement vanished. Left out rather than shipped on a technicality.

title: Added a minimum-value threshold for transfers
description: Free transfers had no cost in the model, so it would take any transfer with even a hair of positive value - found live when it wanted to swap the backup goalkeeper for one worth 0.2 points more over five weeks, a player who'll almost certainly never actually play. Transfers now need to clear a real minimum bar to be worth making, same idea as the existing cost for paid transfers beyond the free allowance.

title: Fixed a single-game form spike distorting captaincy
description: With only one gameweek played all season, FPL's rolling form stat is just that one game's score, not an average. A defender's freak 17-point haul in gameweek 1 (clean sheet plus a big bonus) showed as red-hot form and nearly won him the captaincy over established players - 19 players had similarly inflated form at the time this was caught. Form now ramps up in trust as a player builds a real sample this season, instead of being taken at face value from game one.
